aliases: source control sidebar section pull request merge request code review forge
collisionPolicy: id must be unique across source-control.sections; additive plugins contribute a section and do not replace the Source Control sidebar

verification.postcondition: the contributed section is mounted for an active Git repository and is removed with its plugin lifecycle

minimalUsage: inject SOURCE_CONTROL_SECTIONS_SERVICE and lifecycle-own SourceControlSectionRegistry.register through context.effect with context.pluginId, context.generation, and a unique key; use repoRoot, workspace, and runInNewTerminal from SourceControlSectionProps
